title: Agent Harness Profile 0.1 write-ledger entry
description: One entry of the exactly-once write ledger, keyed by (scope.tenant, scope.principal, scope.operation, idempotency_key). In-flight states (intent, approved) carry response null; terminal states (executed, denied, expired, failed) carry the stored response that is replayed for a repeated request. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

$schema.description: Opt-In. URI of this JSON Schema. When present it MUST be exactly this schema's $id.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Idempotency key supplied with the write (HTTP Idempotency-Key header as a Structured Field String, or MCP _meta["com.orbanplatform/idempotency-key"]).

scope.description: Required. Key scope. The same key in a different scope is a different entry.

principal.description: Required. Principal id of the caller (the agent).

operation.description: Required. Operation, normally the tool name.

fingerprint.description: Required. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of JCS(arguments) of the first request with this key. A later request with the same key and a different fingerprint is rejected with 422.

task_id.description: Required. Task that first used the key. The same key from a different task is rejected with 409.

run_id.description: Required. Run that first used the key.

state.description: Required. intent (recorded, not yet approved or executed), approved, executed, denied, expired or failed.

approval_request_id.description: Required (may be null). id of the approval request gating this write, or null if none was needed (for example over_limit below the limit).

response.description: Conditionally Required: an object in terminal states (the stored response, for denied, expired and failed an RFC 9457 problem details object), null in intent and approved.

created_at.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time the entry was created.

updated_at.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time of the last state change.

retain_until.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time until which the entry is kept. At least 24 hours after the entry reached a terminal state; the retention period MUST be published by the implementation.
